protocol.geometry_confound: The frozen design couples light index to -8/0/+8 degree rotation plus fixed translation. Strata may reflect geometry as well as illumination; these are not isolated causal lighting effects.
protocol.support: Intensity proxy from raw physical I/F values, not binary Sun visibility, shadow truth, or a causal lighting estimate. Missing valid area remains unknown.
